component.name: TjipTemp
component.summary: Control, log and calibrate TjipTemp thermometer boards

description.p: Desktop software for the TjipTemp ESP32-S3 thermometer board: a PT1000 in 2-, 3- or 4-wire configuration, a type-K thermocouple, six NTC thermistors, battery and supply monitoring, and an AHT20 humidity sensor.

ul.li: Live plotting of every channel over USB, WiFi or Bluetooth LE
Recording with fitted UTC timestamps and gap backfill
Calibration wizard writing coefficients to the board's memory
Export to CSV, Excel, Parquet and publication-quality figures
Local REST and WebSocket API for other programs
Control of the board's 240x320 display, which has no buttons of its own

description.p: Fixes from testing against a real DIN-6 board: the live view no longer freezes after a lost frame, recordings name channels the way the board does, the simulator panel shows how far its table reaches, clock drift is fitted from minutes of data, and an AppImage that runs on any Linux.
A tracker-style colour scheme: tan frames, and black display boxes with yellow values and green labels, on a white or black ground.
